hero.title: Your wedding invitation, in one link
hero.subtitle: Design an invitation that opens on any phone in seconds, send it on WhatsApp, and see who is coming.

fast.title: Opens instantly
fast.body: The invitation is a light page that opens on a weak connection and an old phone. Nothing to install, nothing to wait for.

arabic.title: Arabic first
arabic.body: Direction, typography and the calendar are Arabic from the ground up — not a translation added afterwards.

rsvp.title: Replies built in
rsvp.body: Guests reply without an account and without an app. You see the count and export it to Excel.

privacy.title: No tracking
privacy.body: We set no cookies on your invitation and store no guest IP addresses. You learn how many opened it, not who they are.

templates.title: Templates
templates.subtitle: Every template is designed for Arabic first, and for the phone before anything else.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Pay once per invitation. No monthly subscription and no automatic renewal.
pricing.note: Prices are shown in your market's currency and include the tax that applies there.
pricing.comingSoon: Plans and prices will be announced before launch.

q1.q: Do my guests need an app?
q1.a: No. The invitation is a link that opens in any browser, and a guest replies on the invitation itself without an account.

q2.q: Can I edit the invitation after sending it?
q2.a: Yes. Every publish saves a complete copy, so your edits stay invisible to guests until you publish them — and you can return to any earlier version.

q3.a: Your invitation is not listed in search engines by default. But anyone holding the link can open it and pass it on — a link is not a password.

q4.q: What happens to my guests' details?
q4.a: The names and numbers of people who reply belong to you alone. Our staff cannot read them, and we do not use them for anything else.

q5.q: How long does the invitation stay up?
q5.a: For a while after the wedding, then it closes automatically. The link says so plainly rather than looking broken.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Zfaf. By using the platform you agree to them.

s1.title: Your account
s1.body: You are responsible for the accuracy of your account details and for protecting your password. Tell us immediately if you suspect unauthorised access.

s2.title: What you upload
s2.body: The photographs and text you upload remain yours. You give us a limited permission to display them inside your invitation only, and we use them for nothing else. You confirm you have the right to use them.

s3.title: What is not allowed
s3.body: Impersonating someone, publishing content that infringes others' rights, or using the platform to harass people. We may suspend an invitation that does, and we record the reason.

s4.title: Music
s4.body: The available tracks are licensed for use inside invitations. Uploading your own is not offered, because we cannot verify its rights.

s5.title: Availability
s5.body: We do what we can to keep invitations reachable, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted service. We are not liable for indirect losses.

s6.title: Changes
s6.body: We may update these terms. Material changes are emailed to you before they take effect.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what we collect and what we do not. It is written to be read, not signed.

s1.title: Your account data
s1.body: Your email, your name, and what you write in your invitation. We use them to run the service and to contact you about it, and we sell them to nobody.

s2.title: Your guests
s2.body: Someone who replies gives us their name, and possibly a number and a note. That data is yours: it appears in your dashboard, and you can export and delete it. Platform staff cannot read it — that is enforced in the system itself, not merely stated in a policy.

s3.title: Analytics
s3.body: We count views with no cookies and store no IP address. A visitor is represented by a hash derived from a daily key that is never persisted and expires within a day — so once the day is over, nobody, ourselves included, can link a visit to a person or link two visits together.

s4.title: Cookies
s4.body: The public invitation page sets no cookies at all. The dashboard uses one session cookie, which is necessary to keep you signed in, and nothing else.

s5.title: Who we share with
s5.body: The hosting, storage and email providers the service runs on, to the minimum extent needed. No advertisers and no data brokers.

s6.title: Your rights
s6.body: You can request a copy of your data or delete your account. Deletion removes your invitations and your guests' replies after a grace period.

s7.title: Contact
s7.body: For any privacy question, write to <email>privacy@zfaf.app</email>.
